result.summary: Several visual and content issues: duplicate restaurant cards, truncated names, and incomplete category pills that hurt polish and scannability.

issues.description: Under 'Fastest near you', the first two cards are identical (same Green Bowl Poké image, name, time, and delivery fee), which looks like a data or rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Ensure unique nearby restaurants are loaded and remove duplicate entries from the list.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card title is truncated to 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on tap; ensure card width accommodates typical names.

issues.description: Category filter row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' and next pill), with no clear affordance that more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/scroll hint or ensure horizontal scroll is obvious; keep active and key filters fully visible.

issues.description: Bottom of the pizza card is clipped by the tab bar, so the offer/image feels incomplete when scrolling stops.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so the last card clears the navigation bar.
